name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre Dubois, a name synonymous with meticulousness in motorsport, hails from Montreal. His journey began not in the driver's seat, but in his father's auto repair shop, where he learned the intricacies of vehicle mechanics from the ground up. A chance encounter with a local racing team needing a detail-oriented mechanic set him on his path. Jean-Pierre's relentless pursuit of perfection quickly made him an invaluable asset.

Jean-Pierre joined Full Time Sports fifteen years ago and has become a cornerstone of their quality control division. His approach is simple: every component, every system, every process must meet the highest standards. He believes that even the smallest imperfection can have disastrous consequences on the track. He is known for his uncanny ability to identify potential failures before they occur, often relying on his gut feeling honed by years of experience. His commitment to excellence has earned him the respect of his colleagues and rivals alike. Jean-Pierre isn't just checking boxes; he's safeguarding performance.

physical.description: A stocky man with a perpetually serious expression, Jean-Pierre looks like he's perpetually evaluating the structural integrity of everything he sees.

quirks: Always carries a small magnifying glass to inspect parts.
Insists on using a specific brand of wrench, claiming it provides better torque.
Taps his pen rhythmically on his clipboard when deep in thought, a sound that can drive some colleagues crazy.
